title: ROME edit bank compressed by shared basis and factor views
hypothesis: A shared basis with small factor-addressed coefficients stores held-out compositional rank-one edits with lower complete payload bytes while retaining efficacy/locality; Mirror-specific credit requires beating ordinary low-rank and additive factor-table controls.

task.key_vectors: one-hot basis vectors generated by schema and charged by edit index

fit_policy: SVD basis fit only on the 12 visible edits; coefficient factor tables fit only on those edits. Mirror heldout coefficient vectors are generated solely by the factor tables fit on training pairs; heldout target deltas are used only for efficacy/locality audit. Independent and per-edit low-rank controls receive their native requested edit deltas.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes, including original layer, edit values/basis, factor tables or codes, edit IDs/key indices, schema and metadata.
success_gate: Both development seeds: held-out efficacy nRMSE <=1e-5, locality leakage <=1e-6, and complete payload <=50% independent rank-one payload. Mirror-specific success additionally requires strict frontier gain over native additive factorization at equal quality.
failure_gate: Quality/locality/storage miss or exact native factor-table alias. Fresh sealed after failure.
boundaries: No pretrained-model factuality or generalization claim
